resources.string: Pocket 4P RC is installed and supports Osmo Pocket 4 Pro.\n\nReturn to osmodule, connect the camera, then tap Remote beside its status.
Step 1 of 2 · From the gallery this plugin reuses Base’s camera Wi-Fi; a direct launch may join the camera’s local network itself. Android requires Nearby Wi-Fi permission for that fallback.
Step 2 of 2 · HyperOS also requires Autostart for Base to open this plugin reliably. Android does not expose this as a runtime permission, so confirm it manually in the system screen.
